info.syllabusName: Chuyên đề định hướng nghề nghiệp - Kinh doanh quốc tế (Career in International Business)
info.description:
This subject includes 2 main parts:

First: Provide students with basic knowledge about the specialization of the major, the graduate programme, the job opportunities after graduation; Introduce students to specific job positions, qualification requirements, professional knowledge needed to tackle the job well; Orientate students to take initiative in preparing foreign languages, informatics and vocational certificates required in a number of typical jobs in a dynamic integrated business environment; Develop occupational interest, form the corresponding occupational capacity in a broad integrated economic environment; Orientate students to equip themselves for the sense of discipline, collective respect for community, colleagues, always put personal interest associated with collective interests..

Second: The final section introduces students to individual branding, this is a matter which human resources and talent managers use to develop human resources for businesses and social organizations. The purpose of this section is to guide students the need of personal branding from the start when pursueing profession, specifically, the application of branding method to set up individual plan from the point of view of marketing to external customers, that is to understand the customer (the employer, the parties involved) from which to find solutions to meet the needs of this group, making customers happy, help them look for jobs that are suitable for their individual ability.

Understand the program agenda, the general subjects, the purpose of each group of courses: basic courses, specialized courses, core subjects branch graduation requirements
